title: Black Bob "4 B's" keychain
subtitle: Concept C2d: a big tilted, cropped BB framed by the four B's · 56 mm square · red, white, black · shown hanging · millimetres
scale_note: Real size: 56 mm square (the concept sketch's size), 63 mm tall with the tab. Type 60 in the real-size box to preview the first keychain's size.
notes_title: v1: first build of concept C2d
notes: Two Liberation Sans Bold Bs (29 mm tall), tilted 45°, the first one 8 mm higher, overlapping, and cropped by the white window. No gap where they overlap: the front (right) B stands 0.8 mm above the back one, and that step separates them. The black line sits on the inside edge of the red frame. Heights: window 2.4, back B 3.2, frame and line 3.4, frame text 3.8, front B 4.0. Look at the overlap from a low angle: is the step enough? Also check that "BE THE BEST YOU" (shrunk to 3.2 mm to fit its side) reads OK.
